protocol.purpose: Calculation reliability only; no outcomes, strategy optimization or episode generation
protocol.causalityComparison: Exact equality of decision-time projections at the identical history origin; no tolerance
protocol.normalization: Price deltas / longest past-only reference ATR when finite and positive; RSI differences are points, never price/ATR errors
protocol.referenceLimitation: Longest available past-only prefix is a reference, not proof of absolute convergence; no acceptance/error budget is optimized

limits: Longest available past-only history is a reference, not absolute convergence
Fixed 24-point schedule is not an exhaustive test or a regime/performance sample
EMA13/200/800 and VWAP are context; EMA50/ATR/RSI and pattern/target votes are measured separately
Future recovery/supersession metadata is intentionally censored to what was known at the decision close; raw future caches are not causal snapshots
No bootstrap, calc(), backtest(), browser storage, research outcomes or live-policy changes executed
